name: Verdika
promise: See what people experience. Put what needs fixing in front of the right people.
description: Verdika turns feedback, ratings and votes into clear patterns and accountable next actions. It can be configured to send relevant feedback to the responsible stakeholder. Its public civic application lets people rate public leaders and institutions and state what they want changed.
situation: Customers, members, staff or the public have an experience an organisation needs to understand.
system: Verdika captures feedback, ratings and votes, shows the patterns and can route relevant feedback to the responsible stakeholder.
visible: Leaders see what people experience, what needs attention and who needs to act next.
buyer: Businesses, institutions and public bodies that need to understand customer, employee or public experience.
measure: Feedback reaching the right stakeholder; time to respond; recurring issues.

name: Varren
promise: Turn a commercial brief into work your team can approve, run and prove.
description: Varren turns an approved objective and brand truth into a grounded plan, content and governed action. It keeps approval, timing, destination and proof together, so work is not released blindly and the organisation retains a record of what happened.
situation: Commercial work is scattered between plans, drafts, approvals and channels. No one can clearly show what was approved or what actually happened.
system: Varren prepares the brief, holds consequential steps for approval and sends through authorised connections. It records what happened for later recommendations.
visible: Your team sees the objective, draft, approval, chosen destination and verified receipt in one place.
buyer: Organisations that need research, plans, content, approvals and authorised commercial action to work together.
measure: Time from brief to approval; completed actions; verified delivery records.

name: Varren Aegis
promise: Find platform weaknesses before they become customer-visible work.
description: Varren Aegis watches a live digital platform, runs system checks and scheduled user journeys, then turns a finding into clear work with its cause, priority, responsible role, expected effort and a test for closure. It keeps a record and recommends the next action.
situation: A live platform can appear healthy while a broken flow, risky configuration or weak system behaviour quietly affects customers.
system: Aegis runs scheduled checks and tester journeys. It records each changed finding, explains the cause and raises the next job to the responsible role.
visible: Teams see what failed, why it matters, who can act and whether the fix has been verified.
buyer: Teams responsible for live websites, platforms and digital services.
measure: Time to detect issues; time to resolve them; successful repeat checks.

name: Varren Herald
promise: Give customers a real reason to come back.
description: Herald finds a meaningful event in the organisation's record, checks the permission rules and uses an approved message only when the contact is justified.
situation: A customer has stopped before an important step in a service or journey.
system: Herald identifies a real occasion, applies contact rules and measures recovery against a held-back group.
visible: Teams see the occasion, approval, action and recovery measure in one record.
buyer: Service businesses and platform teams that want to bring customers back for a useful, timely reason.
measure: Recovered customer journeys; contact quality; response and opt-out rates.

name: LisBon Signal Infrastructure (LSI)
promise: Know what the financial records really say.
description: LSI validates financial records, flags anomalies or possible tampering, and produces structured signals on income, obligations, expenses, cash flow, account stability and document integrity.
situation: A credit team receives financial records that must be checked before a consequential decision.
system: LSI validates records, flags anomalies or possible integrity issues and produces structured signals for the decision workflow.
visible: The team sees what the records say, what needs review and the evidence behind it.
buyer: Banks, lenders, fintechs and teams that need reliable signals from financial records.
measure: Review time; records requiring investigation; completeness of decision evidence.

name: LisBon Trust Infrastructure (LTI)
promise: Know who qualifies for credit, what they can safely take and why.
description: LTI applies verified signals and a lender's own rules to calculate eligibility, affordability and exposure limits, then preserves a replayable decision record. It supports individuals, businesses and institutions.
situation: A lender, fintech or capital provider must decide who may access credit, how much is appropriate and why.
system: LTI applies the lender's rule to verified evidence and produces an eligibility, affordability and exposure decision record.
visible: The lender sees the evidence, rule, limit and reason together.
buyer: Banks, lenders, fintechs and capital providers assessing individuals, businesses or institutions.
measure: Decision turnaround; policy consistency; affordability and exposure records.

name: LisCredit Marketplace
promise: Bring verified demand and capital providers together.
description: LisCredit enables banks, fintechs and funds to assess opportunities and provide capital under their own rules. Capital providers retain their lending decision and risk.
situation: An eligible borrower needs a clearer route to a suitable capital provider.
system: LisCredit matches the borrower to relevant partner routes under each provider's rules.
visible: Providers see relevant applications and borrowers see a clearer next step.
buyer: Banks, fintechs and funds looking for relevant, evidence-backed credit applications.
measure: Relevant applications; time to review; progress through provider decisions.

name: Trust App
promise: Build the financial profile behind your next credit application.
description: Trust App lets people submit financial records, see their Trust Profile and available credit access, and view relevant opportunities. It can also be deployed as a lender-branded customer journey.
situation: A person needs to understand their financial standing before they seek access.
system: Trust App turns the available evidence into a clear profile and next step.
visible: People see their profile and providers retain a connected customer journey.
buyer: Lenders and institutions that need a clear financial-profile and credit-application journey for customers.
measure: Profile completion; application completion; customer support requests.

name: LisBon Flow Infrastructure (LFI)
promise: Run your movement business. Keep your brand and customers.
description: LFI gives transport, logistics and delivery businesses and operators booking, customer access, driver operations, dispatch, routes, delivery and settlement in one environment. It can be deployed under the operator's own brand, pricing and customer relationship.
situation: A transport, logistics or delivery business runs bookings, routes, teams and service updates across disconnected tools.
system: LFI connects booking, customer access, driver operations, dispatch, routes, delivery and settlement around the real service.
visible: The business sees what is moving, who owns the next task and what needs attention.
buyer: Transport, logistics and delivery businesses that want connected operations under their own brand.
measure: Booking completion; delivery time; dispatch effort; settlement exceptions.

name: Flow App
promise: Every route, booking and update in one place.
description: Flow App gives customers, drivers and operators a clear experience of booking, execution and status within an LFI deployment. It is the customer-facing experience, not a generic standalone app.
situation: A customer or driver needs a clear view of the journey that is happening now.
system: Flow App presents the booking, route, task and service update around the real movement.
visible: Every person involved sees the next step without leaving the operator's service.
buyer: Transport and logistics businesses that need a connected booking and service experience for customers and drivers.
measure: Booking completion; status enquiries; completed journeys.

name: Pollenair
promise: Show which learners can use what they learned.
description: Pollenair delivers interactive skill pathways and gives institutions a clear view of participation, progress and completion across a sponsored programme.
situation: A sponsor needs to see whether a learning programme is reaching people and moving them forward.
system: Pollenair gives learners practical pathways and gives sponsors a view of progress and completion.
visible: Programme teams see participation, progress and where support is needed.
buyer: Institutions, employers and sponsors running practical skills programmes.
measure: Participation; progress; completion; learners needing support.

name: Focused AlphaIT Build
promise: Find the missing piece. Build the system that makes the operation work.
description: When a ready system does not fully fit, AlphaIT studies the real operation, finds the missing handoff, information or control, then architects and engineers the connected solution.
situation: A ready system covers much of an operation, but a missing handoff, control or data connection still creates delay, rework or avoidable cost.
system: AlphaIT maps the real operation, identifies the gap and engineers the smallest connected solution that closes it.
visible: The team sees a complete working route and can measure the change in cost, delay, revenue opportunity, service or control.
buyer: Organisations whose service, process or new offering cannot be served fully by an existing system.
measure: The agreed change in cost, time, service quality, visibility or revenue opportunity.
